why: A connected group could be committed correctly but its ghost omitted utility corridors and gave no native invalid-destination feedback before placement.
change: Copy and building-move previews use a disposable worker with the same native compiler as commit. Source definition transfers once per gesture/context; pointer deltas are debounced, at most one native check runs, and only the latest requested cell can publish. Valid previews draw native internal corridor plans. Blocked previews show red footprints plus a written reason. Escape, document/tool changes and gesture cancellation discard results and terminate the worker; stalled checks time out. Commit remains independently validated.
browser_checks: Nine-building native allowed preview with five internal connections; occupied destination blocked; blocked click preserves definition and history; feedback persists after normal pointer release; Escape clears status and ghost; reselection/copy/move retains exact atomic undo/redo/reload. No page errors and bounded browser cleanup passed.
lifecycle_checks: Controlled fake workers prove one in-flight request, latest-cell coalescing, same-cell deduplication, stale/cancelled/old-document isolation, error fallback and timeout termination. Existing real EditorMap controlled release-handler contract also passes; it is not a trusted gesture benchmark.
visual_review: Individually inspected both final full desktop captures. Valid ghost shows five dashed utility corridors; occupied ghost has warm red borders and readable textual placement reason. Both notices sit below the top controls without covering the tool belt.
performance: Final 256 mixed-building headless SwiftShader gesture repeat completed with cleanup. Group-motion handler p95 6.8 ms and release handler 90.8 ms; two-frame observations 12.9/97.9 ms. Removed redundant synchronous preview redraws after an earlier repeat measured 16.2/104.3 ms handlers. These single-gesture observations are not a sustained hardware pacing guarantee.
limits: This native preview covers copied building groups and dragged buildings/groups. Other placement tools, maximum connected groups, GPU memory, physical display pacing, worker failure in a real browser and unfamiliar-player acceptance remain separate. Preview compiles only after a short pointer pause and may still be checking at immediate click; commit always validates independently.
